02 SET DESIGN

Your show,
your backdrop.

It’s the same upstairs room in each layout. Try two chairs, a presenter desk or a demo bench. For a returning show, we can keep the lighting, logo and camera framing on file.

Plan this set ↗
SET MONITORILLUSTRATED CONCEPT

03 AT THE CONTROLS

Three angles.
A mixed master.

Three Sony ZV-E10 cameras cover the room. Three Shure microphones sit on individual boom arms. The Mackie ProFX12v3+ handles the programme mix, and the technician uses the ATEM Mini Pro, OBS and Stream Deck to run the session.

The standard assisted handoff is a switched HD video and a copy of the mixed audio. If your editor needs the individual cameras or audio tracks, specify that in advance so we can confirm the capture plan.
